title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AN INCREASE OF THE CLERICAL FORCE IN THE OFFICE OF THE DISBURSING QUARTERMASTER, CIVIL BUREAUS.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AN INCREASE OF THE CLERICAL FORCE IN THE OFFICE OF THE DISBURSING QUARTERMASTER, CIVIL BUREAUS.

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00027_1900_html.txt

text.en:
Authority is hereby given for the employment of two additional clerks in the office of the
Disbursing Quartermaster, Civil Bureaus, one at a salary of one hundred dollars per month, and one year at a
salary of fifty dollars per month, in money of the United States.

This Act shall take effect on its passage
Enacted, October 24, 1900.
